hero.ability1: Foresight of the Void: At the start of your turn, draw 2 cards instead, then Discard 1.
hero.ability2: Fate's Toll: The first five times you Discard cards from your Hand or Deck each turn, inflict 1 damage to a Hero. This does not work with Sacrifce Card.
hero.ability3: Arcane Inversion: You may play any card in Reversed orientation (facing your opponent) to reduce its Lifeforce cost by 1. If you do, your Hero takes 2 damage.
hero.ability4: Threads of Destiny: Once during each of your turns, you may shuffle your Hand into your Deck then draw that many cards.

card.effects:
Upright: Destroy all cards on the field. Each player shuffles their Graveyard into their Deck. Costs 1 less for each card you control. 

Reversed: Negate all card text on Enemy Minions, then Destroy them. Gain 1 Lifeforce for each Destroyed.

Upright: Resurrect 2 Minions from your Graveyard with a combined cost of 8 or less. 

Reversed: Choose up to 2 Minions from your Graveyard; Shuffle one into your Deck and Resurrect the other to the field.

Upright: If you control a Minion but an enemy Hero controls more than you, Destroy their lowest cost Minions until you control the same amount. 

Reversed: Draw cards until you have the same amount as an enemy Hero.

Upright: Target a friendly Minion; it gains +3 Attack until end of turn. 

Reversed: During any turn, you may Target a friendly Minion, it gains +3 Defense until end of turn.

Upright: Draw 1 card. 

Reversed: Discard 1 card, gain 3 Lifeforce.

card.traits: Upright: This Minion can attack twice.
card.effects: Reversed: On your turn, if this Minion’s attack would destroy it’s Target, avoid taking damage.

card.traits: Upright: At the end of your turn, inflict 3 damage to an enemy Hero.
card.effects: Reversed: When this minion Destroys an enemy Minion, gain 2 Lifeforce.

card.traits: Upright: Once during your turn, Target an enemy Minion with less Attack than this card's Defense and force it to be Dismissed.
card.effects: Reversed: When enemy Minions enter the field, their Attack values are reduced by 2 until the end of the turn.

card.traits: Upright: On Summon, Heal any Hero for 5 Health.
card.effects: Reversed: All friendly Minions cost 1 less Lifeforce to play from your Hand while this card is on the field.

card.traits: Upright: On Summon, you may Summon a 1-cost Minion from your Hand, Deck, or Graveyard.
card.effects: Reversed: Summon this card on an enemy Minion slot. On Death, the original owner draws 1 card. Cannot be Dismissed.

card.traits: Upright: At end of your turn, Destroy this Minion to Resurrect a Minion of cost 3 or less from your Graveyard. If destroyed this way, Resurrect this at the start of your next turn.
card.effects: Reversed: Destroy a Minion. Resurrect it to the owner’s field at your turn’s start.

card.traits: Upright: If this is your only Minion on the field, it gains +3 Attack and +3 Defense.
card.effects: Reversed: On Summon, Target an enemy Hero, if they only control 1 Minion, inflict 2 damage to them and draw a card.

card.traits: Upright: Once during your turn, you may cast a 4 or less cost Spell from your Graveyard, then Banish it to the Void.
card.effects: Reversed: Once during your turn, when you cast a Spell of cost 3 or less, draw 1 card and gain 1 Lifeforce.

card.traits: Upright: On Summon, draw 3 cards, then Discard 2 from your Hand.
card.effects: Reversed: While this is on the field, enemy Minions lose their Traits.

Upright: Choose two friendly Minions. Each gains +2 Attack until the end of the turn. 

Reversed: During any turn, choose two enemy Minions. Each loses 2 Defense until the end of the turn.

card.traits: Upright: On Summon, declare a card name; Banish all cards with that name from all Graveyards sending them to the Void.
card.effects: Reversed: Playable any turn. If used in response to a non-Spell Magic, negate that card's effects until the next turn.

Upright: At the end of your turn, your Minions gain Invisibility, becoming untargetable until they attack or take damage. 

Reversed: Enemy Minions cannot attack the turn they are Summoned.

Upright: Shuffle 3 cards in your Graveyard into your Deck, then Draw a card.

Reversed: Reveal the top 3 cards of your Deck, add 1 to your Hand, place one on top of your Deck, Discard the last one.

Upright: While active, your Minions are not Ensnared and cannot be Ensnared. 

Reversed: While active, enemy Minions are not Invisible and cannot be Invisible.

Upright: Your Magic cards cannot be destroyed by Destroy Magic.

Reversed: While active, all enemy Magic Cards have their effects negated.

At the start of your turn: 

Upright: Draw 1 card for each Minion you control. (Max 3) 

Reversed: Gain 1 Lifeforce for each Minion you control.

Once during your turn, Discard the top card of your Deck. 

Upright: If it's a Minion, draw 2 cards. 

Reversed: If it's a Magic card, inflict 4 damage to an enemy Hero.
